      Residential, MR - Medium Density Residential, CB - Community Business, and MUR -

      of Dell Range Boulevard and west of Powderhouse Road. (SPONSOR – MR. COOK)

      (SPONSOR – MR. COOK)

26.   RESOLUTION – Granting an exception to the ‘201 Agreement’ for the owner of the

      sewage holding tanks (septic system) located within Laramie County. (SPONSOR – MR.
